verdict.rationale: Mercury Books explicitly claims automatic, continuous, real-time reconciliation of banking, card, and other transaction data (mercury-books-supp-auto-rec, mercury-books-supp-launch), and its own honest-scope post acknowledges that full automation still leaves items needing human review (mercury-books-supp-honest-scope), implying some exception-surfacing workflow. However, none of the evidence explicitly describes a matched/unmatched/duplicate transaction review screen for bank reconciliation specifically — the only duplicate-detection claim found (mercury-books-docs-13) is scoped to bill pay, not bank-to-ledger reconciliation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a reconciliation review UI showing matched vs unmatched vs duplicate bank transactions, and independent/hands-on confirmation that discrepancies are surfaced rather than silently auto-categorized.
